summary: Navigation list for portals and admin panels: links with icon and badge, single-level expandable groups, a collapsed rail with tooltips, and a scrollable horizontal variant.
whenToUse: Primary navigation of an admin sidebar or a portal.
Horizontal sub-navigation between sections of a page (Overview, Activity, Settings…).
Icon-only collapsed vertical rail when space is limited.
whenNotToUse: Switching panels within the same page without changing the URL: use Tabs.
Global navigation with flyout menus in the header: use NavigationMenu.
Primary mobile navigation with 3–5 destinations: use BottomNavigation.

props.name: items
props.description: Links { id, label, href, icon?, badge?, isDisabled?, linkProps? } or groups { id, label, icon?, items: NavListLink[] } (a single level of nesting).

props.name: currentId
props.description: Id of the current page: receives aria-current="page"; the group containing it is highlighted and expanded by default.

props.name: orientation
props.description: In horizontal orientation, groups are flattened into their links.

props.name: variant
props.description: Style of the current item: side indicator, filled pill or underline.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Shows the button to collapse/expand the rail (vertical only).

props.name: collapsed / defaultCollapsed / onCollapsedChange
props.description: Icon-only rail state, controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when a link is clicked: integrate a router with event.preventDefault() without dependencies.

inherits: HTML attributes of <nav> (id, style, data-*), except aria-label, which is replaced by label.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between links, groups and the collapse button.
Follows the link or opens/closes the group.
Opens/closes the group or activates the collapse button.

accessibility: Semantic structure: <nav aria-label> with <ul>/<li> and real <a> elements; no menu role.
The current page is indicated by aria-current="page", not by color alone.
Groups are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the sub-list.
In the collapsed rail, labels remain in the accessible name (visually hidden) and appear as tooltips on focus and hover.
The collapse button uses the localized strings “Comprimi/Espandi navigazione”.
Icons are aria-hidden; indicators and focus remain visible in forced-colors mode.
responsive: In horizontal orientation the list scrolls locally (overflow-x) below 768px and wraps from 768px up.
Targets are at least 40px tall; in the rail, items are square.
Chevron and collapse icons are mirrored in RTL.
customization: Tokens: --dc-look-radius-control, --dc-look-fill-tonal, action colors and focus ring.
commonMistakes: Omitting currentId: users lose their sense of orientation.
Nesting more than one level: the structure only supports group → link.
Using the collapsed rail without meaningful icons: items show only an initial.
Placing actions (e.g. “Log out”) as navigation links: use a separate Button.

examples.name: WithGroups
examples.title: With groups
examples.description: The group containing the current page is open by default.

examples.name: CollapsibleRail
examples.title: Collapsible rail
examples.description: Controlled state and router integration via onNavigate.

limits: A single level of nesting (group → link).
In horizontal orientation, groups are flattened and collapsing is ignored.
Rail tooltips cannot be reached on touch devices; labels still remain in the accessible name.
No arrow-key navigation (roving tabindex): Tab is used as with regular links.
